facts.text: Back in my day we had grease and arguments. Here everything is healthy and I get fined for swearing.
facts.why: Spartan never says this. It is a made-up line signed with his name. The fines for swearing are real, but the Wikiquote page has his real food line, said about the rat burger the Scraps sell underground.
facts.fix: Not bad! Matter of fact, this is the best burger I've had in years!

fix_note.text: Not bad! Matter of fact, this is the best burger I've had in years!

facts.text: Huxley's idea of a big night out.
facts.why: Nothing in the sources shows Huxley choosing guacamole or a night out. Her thing is 20th century culture and virtual sex. What the sources do show is Spartan unimpressed by the idea of dinner and dancing at a fast food place.
facts.fix: Dinner and dancing at Taco Bell.

vibe.verdict: Taco Bell, the morality slip and the rat burger are all there, so the world is spot on, but the writing stays safe and the best food speech is missing.
